paragraphs.text: The following Ixalani characters are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.

Eztli is a heroic Oltec human and member of the Thousand Moons. She flies with the aid of a giant bat and has long braids. She is the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Starling, Aerial Ally .

The Grim Captain is an undead pirate captain. They are composed of the reanimated skeletons of a dinosaur , a merfolk , a human pirate , and a vampire . The Grim Captain and their eponymous Locker are likely references to the idiom " Davy Jones's locker ," a metaphor for the oceanic depths.

Tarrian was a legendary hero and Venerable of the Legion of Dusk . He was a travel companion of Elenda of Garrano , with whom he entered the Temple of Aclazotz around 4162 AR . He recorded his travels in a journal, later declared heretical due to its reverent writings on Aclazotz, although more radical sects of the Church of Dusk view it as holy. Centuries later, Vito Quijano de Pasamonte carried Tarrian's journal as well as his lance, known as Tarrian's Soulcleaver. Leading the Queen's Bay Company in 4563, Vito brought the artifacts to Ixalan's Core , where Huatli took the Soulcleaver, slaying him with it.
